## T06 independent verification — FAIL

**3 blocking findings, 1 should-fix.** The focused run passed **97/97** with zero skips on Node v24.22.3. **41/46** independent CLI assertions matched. Two mismatches reproduced the same retry defect. This was a fresh Codex context using the same OpenAI provider.

### Findings

1. **Blocking · T-4/T-5 · Approval can drift between preview and merge.** `project merge P001` previewed commit `82ae879`. After a changed retrospective passed a second `finish`, `project merge P001 --yes` merged `e360b49` and exited `0`. The CLI builds a fresh plan on `--yes` and has no input binding it to the SHA the user reviewed. Within a single invocation, both controls passed. Moving the branch before the second plan caused rejection. Moving it at `git merge --ff-only` still merged the captured SHA and preserved the moved branch. [CLI](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/cli.ts:767) · [Apply](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1546) · [Raw assertions](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/late-results.json)

2. **Blocking · T-4/T-5 · `finish` commits and seals unrelated changes staged by a check.** A declared check changed and staged `outside.txt`, then exited `0`. `finish` exited `0`, committed the changed file, and wrote a matching seal. The final guard checks pending paths under the project and `.pace/team`, while seal generation and the final commit consume the full staged tree. This also contradicts the harness comment that files generated by checks are excluded from the finish commit. [Final guard and staging](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1451) · [Seal](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-finish.ts:33) · [Fixture check](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/check-zero-with-foreign-stage/repo.wt/P001/check-fixture.sh)

3. **Blocking · T-4 · The new seal path causes a legacy false refusal.** A team-free legacy project with an existing `TEAM-FINISH.json` symlink to another file inside the same project failed `finish` with exit `1`. The paired legacy control with a foreign regular file passed `finish` and merge preview. The finish snapshot includes the seal path unconditionally. In adopted projects, tracked and untracked foreign regular files both retained their original bytes and blocked sealing. The untracked file was committed by the intermediate commit before the collision was reported. [Finish snapshot](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1430) · [Snapshot file guard](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:143) · [Raw assertions](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/late-results.json)

4. **Should-fix · T-5 · A rejected merge can block its own retry when the worktree is absent.** The seal correctly rejected post-finish edits and deletion. With no worktree, `merge --yes` appended an untracked project log on main. Restoring the valid sealed commit still left both preview and merge blocked by that log. A fresh, clean fixture with no worktree passed preview and merge. The initial sequential control exposed product-created state that the fixture had assumed would be absent. Both runs are preserved. [Failure log routing](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1706) · [Retry log](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/merge-absent/repo/projects/P001_261124_synthetic/log.jsonl) · [Clean control](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/results.json)

### Criteria and upper goal

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| **T-1 · Request measurement** | **Achieved in scope.** Six CLI stats controls distinguished sent, failed-only, and successful retry. Six reply controls confirmed that a wrong reply ID, a contradictory period or unit, and combined contradictions leave reach unconfirmed. Matching and absent optional fields passed. [Request projection](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-metrics.ts:79) · [Raw results](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/early-results.json) |
| **T-2 · Observations and coverage** | **Achieved in scope.** Focused tests passed for reported totals, missing observations, role attribution, and existing event semantics. A failed check left its own staged output and a failure event, with HEAD, project state, and seal unchanged. A check that exited `0` after deleting the retrospective was caught by the final gate and wrote no seal. [Focused log](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/focused.log) · [Check assertions](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/late-results.json) |
| **T-3 · Comparison and legacy inputs** | **Achieved in scope.** Closed, matching N=2 periods gave `unknown` with reasons and a sample plan when reach fell `2→0` and failed-only rose `0→2`. With successful retries, reach stayed `2→2`, attempts rose `0→2`, failed-only stayed `0→0`, and the independently lower file-edit count `4→2` produced observed burden improvement. Both T01 baseline copies passed through the legacy adapter. Original bytes were preserved, and Roblox’s logged 31 and audited 48 remained separate. [Comparison guard](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-comparison.ts:100) · [Failed-only comparison](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/comparison/compare-1.json) · [Retry comparison](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/comparison/compare-2.json) |
| **T-4 · Retrospective and finish seal** | **Unmet.** All 11 retrospective controls matched, including unquoted HTML rejection, quoted title acceptance, visible labels, balanced destinations, and refusal of an unknown role. The seal rejected edits and deletion with and without a worktree. Clean unchanged merges passed in both modes, and successful previews left the real index byte-identical. Approval drift, staged check output, and the legacy false refusal remain. [Link parser](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:60) · [Private index](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-finish.ts:23) · [All results](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/all-results.json) |
| **T-5 · Source CLI workflow and acceptance** | **Synthetic workflow exercised. Overall acceptance unmet.** `--no-launch` records `runtimeObserved:false`. Current `owner` and existing `by:user` behavior passed. Team projection normalized CR, LF, and CRLF without rewriting input. Whole-document lone CR remains the documented generic harness limitation. The whole suite remains with the PM. [Focused log](/tmp/pace-t06-current.ychqyg/focused.log) · [Start role record](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/team/worker-role.ts:83) |

The design aligns with P009 P-5 and BR01/06/07/09. The measurement contract separates request delivery, manual burden, and quality and supplies BR07 with retrospective input. T06 acceptance remains unmet and T07 retains its own verification obligations. Actual adoption, efficacy, and the live retrospective remain **unknown**, held for the user’s T08 validation after main merge and installation. [P009 scope](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/PROJECT.md:30)

I ran `node --test test/team-metrics.test.ts test/team.test.ts` once. The independent probes made **100** source CLI calls across `new`, `start --no-launch`, `stats`, `compare-team`, `finish`, and `merge`, all in owned synthetic Git and `PACE_HOME` fixtures. The target patch passed reverse-apply checks before and after with the same SHA-256. Concurrent review artifacts changed in the shared workspace during the run. My writes were confined to the temporary evidence directory.
